These are symbols I use. They are always the same size. I will rotate them (except for the dot). When scaling a diagram that contains these symbols, I will either: 1. Scale the grouped figure for that step, then ungroup and replace the symbols that were scaled with new ones of the correct size. or 2. Ungroup and deselect these symbols, scale the figure and place the symbols to their correct positions, then regroup. Can these symbols be taken from here, without having to create new versions?
Squash-fold so the dot meets the line.
